cohort: Primigravida women aged 15-19 years with singleton, term, cephalic pregnancies, excluding those with pre-existing medical or surgical disorders, abortions, or molar pregnancies.
finding: Teenage pregnancies were associated with a higher incidence of complications, with anemia being the most common.
mod_finding: 15.4% of participants underwent LSCS, 8.7% had vaginal deliveries (20.7% induced, 1.3% instrumental).
